data.name: CPB_001
data.value: You have climbed the Celestial Altar...[pause=20] Few mortals ever reach my heights.

data.name: CPB_002
data.value: I am Rayquaza, the Eternal Warden of the Skies.[pause=15] Your intrusion disturbs the celestial dome!

data.name: CPB_003
data.value: The sky burns and the earth trembles due to the disturbances of the Abyss.[pause=20] En garde, foolish ones!

data.name: CPB_004
data.value: Argh...[pause=25] How... How could mere mortals withstand my wrath?

data.name: CPB_005
data.value: That gleam...[pause=15] That light of indomitable determination in your eyes...[pause=20] I have seen it before.

data.name: CPB_006
data.value: Thirty years ago...[pause=20] Another human turned into a Pokémon, accompanied by a partner of peerless courage, stood exactly where you stand now.

data.name: CPB_007
data.value: They challenged me and defeated me to prove their worth,[pause=15] then begged me to destroy the star of destruction that was hurtling towards this world.

data.name: CPB_008
data.value: Are you speaking of the legendary Rescue Team from the great cataclysm thirty years ago?!

data.name: CPB_009
data.value: Yes...[pause=20] You possess the same indomitable spark. The legacy of those legendary saviors flows in your veins.

data.name: CPB_010
data.value: But look up! It cannot be...[pause=20] A SECOND METEORITE!! It's hurtling towards us!

data.name: CPB_011
data.value: The threat of old is reborn, awakened by the disturbances of the Abyss![pause=20] The remnant of the star is back!

data.name: CPB_012
data.value: But as long as I am the Warden of the Skies,[pause=15] the earth shall not be consumed a second time!

data.name: CPB_013
data.value: RAYQUAZA SOARS TOWARDS THE CELESTIAL BODIES, CARRIED BY THE POWER OF THE ATMOSPHERE!

data.name: CPB_014
data.value: With a devastating breath of Hyper Beam, Rayquaza obliterates the giant meteorite in a blinding flash!

data.name: CPB_015
data.value: The meteorite is destroyed![pause=15] Millions of harmless meteors light up the night sky... It is beautiful!

data.name: CPB_016
data.value: But the shockwave over Metano Town...[pause=20] They will believe we triggered the divine wrath!

data.name: CPB_017
data.value: Flee, young heroes...[pause=20] The geomagnetic storm is coming. The humans and Pokémon of the valley will not understand your triumph. They will hunt you as fugitives.

data.name: CPB_R01
data.value: The altar is bare.[pause=20] The wind crosses it without meeting anything.

data.name: CPB_R02
data.value: (He filled the whole sky.[pause=15] Now the sky is just... sky.)

data.name: CPB_R03
data.value: He went back to the upper atmosphere, I think.[pause=20] Wardens don't stay where they've been understood.

data.name: CPB_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.
